props.gloss_en: the mishna: the omasum and the reticulum that were perforated to the outside [-- tereifa]
a needle found in the thickness of the reticulum, from one side -- kosher
a drop of blood found on it -- it is known to be before slaughter
no drop of blood found on it -- it is known to be after slaughter
the mouth of the wound scabbed over -- it is known to be three days before slaughter
the mouth of the wound did not scab over -- one who would extract from his fellow bears the burden of proof
elsewhere there is nothing [for blood] to cling to; here there is a needle, so had it been before slaughter [the blood] would have clung
an incident came before Rebbi: a needle found in the thickness of the reticulum from one side, and he rendered it tereifa
Rav Avira: a needle from one side came before Rebbi; Rebbi turned it over, found a drop of blood on it, and rendered it tereifa
Rebbi: a needle from one side where, on turning [the reticulum] over, a drop of blood is found -- tereifa
Rebbi: if there is no wound there, whence the drop of blood?

supports.gloss_en: טרא טרייה להההוא גברא! מתניתין היא: המסס ובית הכוסות שניקבו לחוץ -- Rebbi's ruling is nothing but the mishna's 'perforated to the outside' (marker מתניתין היא; no support kind for it, svara stands in)

objections.gloss_en: ומאי שנא מכל נקובי דעלמא, דאף על גב דליכא דם טריף מר? -- every other perforation is tereifa though no blood is found; why does the absence of blood here show the perforation came after slaughter?

answered_by.gloss_en: התם ליכא מידי למיסרך, הכא ... מיסרך הוה סריך -- elsewhere nothing would hold the blood; a needle would have held it (= p_machat_mesarechet_dam)
